answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the horizon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the trellis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wharf of the next round.
